dataPath: manual client state / packaged receiver not verified
evidence: Automatic receiver deployment, HMAC secrets, billing, and real Form access were not production-verified.
expectedBehavior: Automatic Forms intake is described as live only after deployment and secret verification.
actualBehavior: Frontend/manual inbox exists; automatic receiver live state is unknown.
userImpact: Organizer may expect automatic intake that is not verified.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Unverified receiver could duplicate, reject, or expose responses if assumed live.
recommendedCorrection: Run a dedicated receiver deployment/security audit before calling automatic intake live.

evidence: Import and bulk registration operations commit in chunks.
expectedBehavior: Operator can clearly recover when a multi-row operation partially succeeds.
actualBehavior: Each chunk is atomic, but the entire operation is not all-or-nothing.
userImpact: Failed later chunk can leave earlier rows committed.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Requires reconciliation after interrupted bulk/import operations.
recommendedCorrection: Add resumable import/bulk operation manifests and post-failure recovery report.

evidence: bulkUpdatePaymentStatus updates paymentStatus only.
expectedBehavior: Bulk status changes either recalculate finance fields or clearly remain status-only cleanup.
actualBehavior: Amount/balance can remain inconsistent until finance update is used.
userImpact: Organizer may create rows that require follow-up data review.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: No data loss, but financial interpretation can be misleading without warnings.
recommendedCorrection: Prefer bulk finance update for financial changes or add stronger UI warning.

evidence: deleteEvent deletes the event document and writes event.delete audit log; related records are not cascaded by the service.
expectedBehavior: Destructive event deletion should document related-record handling.
actualBehavior: No cascade or orphan-report behavior found in service.
userImpact: Deleting a real event could leave scoped registrations/ledger rows without visible event context.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Potential orphaned records and audit interpretation gap.
recommendedCorrection: Before enabling broad event deletion, require related-record impact preview or soft-delete design.

evidence: Audit details usually contain labels, names, type, amount, or flags rather than full before/after snapshots.
expectedBehavior: High-risk financial updates have enough before/after evidence for forensic review.
actualBehavior: Audit is append-only and paired, but summary details limit reconstruction.
userImpact: Harder to review exact change history after disputes.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Forensic completeness gap, not write bypass.
recommendedCorrection: Add structured before/after field diffs for financial/ticket/attendance updates.

evidence: Pass 3 avoided production business-record recomputation.
expectedBehavior: Browser-displayed production totals can be independently matched to raw records in a dedicated acceptance pass.
actualBehavior: Source utilities and tests reviewed; live raw-data recomputation not performed.
userImpact: Remaining evidence gap before declaring production totals independently verified.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: No defect found; verification gap remains.
recommendedCorrection: Run read-only production totals harness for selected event with private evidence handling.

evidence: Reconciliation preview has no apply action.
expectedBehavior: Dry-run handoff clearly directs organizer to audited correction workflows.
actualBehavior: Safe preview exists; manual handoff remains procedural.
userImpact: Organizer may need guidance turning preview rows into corrections.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Safe by default; no write risk.
recommendedCorrection: Document the correction workflow from preview to audited payment updates.

evidence: Role summary says live staff access does not enforce scoped rules yet; Firestore rules contain assigned-event checks.
expectedBehavior: Role wording matches current rules enforcement.
actualBehavior: Wording is more conservative/outdated than rules.
recommendedCorrection: Update wording after a focused role/rules acceptance pass.

evidence: Non-registration target types are listed but conversion workflows are not live.
expectedBehavior: UI does not imply unsupported vendor/sponsor/baker conversion.
actualBehavior: Target types exist for packaging but live conversion is not implemented.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Low if presented as review-only; misleading if called live.
recommendedCorrection: Keep copy explicit: manual review only unless conversion path is implemented.

evidence: commitImport uses 50-row chunks.
expectedBehavior: Partial import failures provide recovery guidance.
actualBehavior: Chunk failure message identifies starting row but no durable operation manifest.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Potential duplicate retry if operator restarts without reviewing committed rows.
recommendedCorrection: Add import run manifest or stronger post-failure report.

evidence: Manual registration save trims phone; import utility normalizes phone.
expectedBehavior: Phone normalization is consistent across manual and import paths.
actualBehavior: Manual values may retain formatting differences.
userImpact: Duplicate/contact matching can be less consistent.

evidence: Tickets are fields on registrations, not standalone ticket documents.
expectedBehavior: Regeneration evidence clearly shows previous and new code.
actualBehavior: Audit detail records previousTicketCode and ticketCode; no standalone invalidated-ticket ledger exists.
userImpact: Usually sufficient, but less rich than a ticket history collection.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Low; QR remains code-only and old code no longer matches registration.
recommendedCorrection: Keep current model unless ticket history becomes a product requirement.

evidence: True 200 percent browser zoom was not completed in Pass 3.
expectedBehavior: High-risk tables/dialogs verified at 200 percent zoom.
actualBehavior: Screenshots/source reviewed; 200 percent zoom remains unverified.
recommendedCorrection: Run dedicated 200 percent zoom visual pass.

evidence: Operations create/update/cancel writes are paired with audit logs, but audit summaries are compact.
expectedBehavior: Financial corrections should retain enough before/after context for independent review.
actualBehavior: Audit logs identify action and key values but do not always capture complete before/after snapshots.
userImpact: Future reconciliation may require opening the current record rather than relying only on the audit log.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Moderate audit completeness gap; no write bypass observed.
recommendedCorrection: Expand financial audit details for before/after values in a future integrity phase.

evidence: Summary calculations separate income and costs from direction/type.
expectedBehavior: Organizer copy should make positive and negative directions unambiguous.
actualBehavior: Calculation code is clear, but UI language can still be tightened around adjustments/refunds.
userImpact: Small risk of misunderstanding operations entries.
recommendedCorrection: Improve wording in the financial-boundaries phase.

evidence: Historical attendance is intentionally separate from live checkedIn state.
expectedBehavior: UI should keep historical confirmation distinct from live check-in.
actualBehavior: Data model is sound; future copy should continue making the distinction explicit.
userImpact: Low risk of confusing historical attendance with event-day scans.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Low; no scanner permission expansion observed.
recommendedCorrection: Keep this distinction explicit in future UI edits.

evidence: Imports preserve source row IDs and audit import origin.
expectedBehavior: Duplicate review should remain easy after failed or repeated imports.
actualBehavior: Source row metadata exists, but there is no durable import-run manifest.
userImpact: Operator may need manual filtering after partial import failure.
integrityOrSecurityImpact: Low to moderate operational recovery gap.
recommendedCorrection: Add import-run manifest if import volume grows.

evidence: Product wording and rules implementation are close but not perfectly aligned.
